title: Indlela yokuQinisekisa kwakhona iNqanaba yeSRD R370
description: Kutheni iSASSA icela abamkeli beSRD baqinisekise izicelo zabo, amanyathelo okuqinisekisa ngokucokisekileyo ku srd.sassa.gov.za kunye neWhatsApp, iifayili zokugcina ukungaphulwa kokukhokelwa, kunye kwenzeka ntoni ukuba uyishiya.

seo.metaTitle: Indlela yokuQinisekisa kwakhona iNqanaba yeSRD R370 (2026 ngamnyathelo)
seo.metaDescription: Qinisekisa kwakhona isicelo sakho seSRD R370: xa iSASSA ifuna, amanyathelo eportal neWhatsApp, iifayili zokugcina zanyanga, kunye neziphumela zokushiya ukuqinisekisa.

contentBlocks.title: Indlela yokuQinisekisa kwakhona iNqanaba yeSRD R370
contentBlocks.description: I-SASSA icela ngamaxesha ethile abamkeli baqinisekise ulwazi lwabo olulungileyo ngaphambi kwejikilela yokukhokelwa. Uphulwa lo mcelo kwaye ukhokelwa kunokumisa — nantsi indlela yokwenza oku ngaphakathi kweemizuzu.

contentBlocks.text: Ukuqinisekisa kukucela iSASSA uqinisekise ukuba ulwazi lwakho, inombolo yocingo kunye neemeko zokufaneleka ziyafana nangaphambili xa usavunyelwe. Kuqalwa yinkqubo yamabhanyathelo yesiseko esidla ngokucolisa — kuninzi emva kokuvuselelwa kwinqanaba okanye xa ifayile yakho imile ixesha elithile.
Umcemo uvela nge-SMS evela kwiindlela ezisemthethweni zeSASSA. Ngenxa yokuba abaduni bathabatha lo mzekelo, rhawula ngalo ndlela ewebhusayithini esemthethweni endaweni yeekhonkco ezikwiimiyalezo.

steps.title: Vula ku srd.sassa.gov.za
steps.description: Sebenzisa ircokhwe lakho okanye elinye onolitsemayo. Iwebhusayithi isebenza kuburawuza beliphi na icala.

steps.title: Khetha 'Qinisekisa isicelo sakho' / inketho yokuqinisekisa
steps.description: Ibonakala kwiluhlu lweNkonzo kwiphepha eyintlo xa ijikilela yokuqinisekisa iqhubeka.

steps.title: Faka inombolo yakho yesazisi kunye nenombolo yocingo
steps.description: Lezi kufuneka zihambisane naleyo iSASSA inayo kwiifestile — khangela inkqubo yethu yokuTshintsha inombolo ukuba ezakho ziyahlukana.

steps.title: Qwalasela isaziso ngasinye
steps.description: Qinisekisa ukuba usahlangabezisa neemfuno zengeniso, awufumani i-UIF/NSFAS ingeniso, kunye nokuba ulwazi lwakho alutshintshanga.

steps.title: Thumela uze ugcine inombolo yokulandelela
steps.description: Ufumana i-SMS yoqinisekiso xa iphunyezwe — ngamanye amaxesha ngaphakathi kweentsuku.

contentBlocks.text: Unqwenela iWhatsApp? Thumela ku 082 046 8553 uthi 'Qinisekisa kwakhona'. Imenyu ikubonisa ngezaziso ezifanayo usebenzisa inombolo yakho yesazisi. Ikhonti yocingo (0800 60 10 11) inokunceda ukuba ungafiki kwi-intanethi.

Iijikilela zokuqinisekisa zivala ngaphambi kokuhamba kwejikilela yokuvunyelwa. Ukuba i-SMS yakho inefayili yokugcina — ngamanye amaxesha ngomjikelezo weenyanga — qinisekisa ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezimbalwa ngaphambi kwayo. Izicelo eziphulwe ijikilela azikhokhelwa kuleyo jikilela; ukuzigqibela kamva kubuyisa iinyanga ezizayo kodwa ayifihli leyo ephulweyo.

contentBlocks.title: Kwenzeke ntoni ukuba uyashiya ukuqinisekisa
contentBlocks.text: Imeko yakho isuka ku 'iphelele' okanye 'inomkhuba', ukukhokelwa kumiswa, kwaye unokufuna ukufaka isicelo entsha endaweni yokwenza nje ukuqinisekisa. Imizuzu embalwa yokugcina ikhusela inyanga yengeniso.
Ukuba ukuqinisekisa kungaphuphlela okanye akwamkeli ulwazi lwakho

Izizathu ezixhaphakileyo kukutshintshwa kwenombolo yocingo, impazamo yesazisi, okanye ifayile ebhalwe ngaphambili. Lungisa ulwazi lokunxibelelana kwakho kuqala, uze uphinde uzame emva kwamaxesha angama-24. Ukungaphuphlela qho kuthetha ukuba kukho into kufayile yakho efuna unakekelo — tyelela nayiphi na iofisi yeSASSA nebhukhwe yakho yesazisi eluhlaza okanye ikhadi eliphilileyo.

Musa ukukhokela umntu wesithathu ukulungisa ifayile ephulweyo. Yonke indlela yokubuyisela ihamba ngendlela zasimahala ezisemthethweni, kwaye abamkeli kwiindawo basebenza ngeefayile eziphulweyo qho ngokuqhelekileyo.

faqs.question: Ndiyenzaphi into yokuqinisekisa inqanaba yam yeSRD?
faqs.answer: Yiya ku srd.sassa.gov.za, khetha inketho yokuqinisekisa, faka isazisi kunye necingo elibhalisiweyo, qwalasele izaziso zokufaneleka, uze uthumele. Unokusebenzisa neWhatsApp 082 046 8553 okanye ubize ku 0800 60 10 11.

faqs.question: Kutheni iSASSA icela ndiqinisekise qho xa kunjalo?
faqs.answer: Ukuhlola ngamaxesha kuuqinisekisa ukuba izimo zakho azizitshintshanga kwaye ulwazi lokunxibelelana lwakho lusasebenza. Yindlela eqhubekayo kude kube kunye neofisi ngonyaka wonke.

faqs.question: Ndiyeke ijikilela yokuqinisekisa. Ndingafumana le nyanga?
faqs.answer: Ngamanye amaxesha hayi — iijikilela eziphulweyo ziyaphinda zikhokhelwe. Qinisekisa ngokukhawuleza nangalonto na ukuze iinyanga ezizayo ziqaqambise, kwaye ukhangise kuphela ukuba imbali yakho ye-SMS ibonisa ukuba isaziso asifikanga kuwe.

faqs.question: Kufanayo na ukuqinisekisa nokukhangisa nyanga ephulweyo?
faqs.answer: Hayi. Ukuqinisekisa kugcina isicelo esivunyelwe siphefile. Ukukhangisa kuqhwanyezana neenyanga ezithile ezivaliweyo ngaphandle kwephaneli — inkqubo eyodwa eneefayili zayo zokugcina.

faqs.question: Imeko yam ibhalwe 'iphelele'. Kuyanele na ukuqinisekisa ukulungisa?
faqs.answer: Ukuba ukuphela kungamva nje kwaye kubangelwe yinkqubo ephulweyo, ukuqinisekisa ngokuqhelekileyo kubuyisa ifayile. Iifayile ezimeleyo ixesha elide ngamanye amaxesha zifuna isicelo esitsha — khangela iphepha lakho lemeko ukuba yeyiphi.

faqs.question: Kuxabisa na ukuqinisekisa?
faqs.answer: Hayi. Naluphi na uhlobo lwabantu okanye iwebhusayithi ekhokelayo ukuqinisekisa yenza ubugqira. Sebenzisa kuphela ku srd.sassa.gov.za, urhwebo lweWhatsApp, ikhonti yocingo, okanye iindawo ezibonakalayo.
